transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. [Your Name]. Well, what made me come in is... I've been having these times where I just eat a lot. Like, after work or class, I’ll sit down with my laptop and end up eating a whole takeout meal, plus chips, sweets, and whatever snacks I have stashed in my desk drawer. It's way more than I ever planned to eat, and honestly, way more than I’d ever eat if anyone else was around.
When you find yourself eating that large amount of food, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?

Yeah, that is exactly it. Once I start, it feels like... I don't know, like I'm just watching myself keep reaching for the next thing. I'll literally be sitting there thinking to myself, Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish, and I know I'm not even enjoying the food anymore. But I just can't seem to make myself stop.
Do these episodes make you feel upset, guilty, or ashamed afterward, or have they started to interfere with your work, school, or social life?

Yeah, I definitely feel ashamed afterward. And it is starting to interfere with things, mostly my social life. I've actually been avoiding plans with my friends and family lately. Like, we usually do these cooking nights, but I keep making excuses to skip them. I'm just really worried they'll somehow notice or figure out how much I've been eating when I'm alone. So, outside of work and my classes, I've just been keeping to myself. I guess I've become pretty isolated.
After these episodes of eating more than you plan to, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or take anything, and I definitely don't exercise a lot afterward. I just kind of sit there with the guilt, honestly.
How often do these episodes of eating more than you plan to happen?

Well, I actually looked back through my journal and... my food delivery charges recently. And it looks like these episodes have been happening most weeks since the restructuring at work started. It's usually more than once a week, so... yeah, it's not just happening here and there anymore. It's pretty frequent.
Have these episodes affected your performance at work or school, or caused you any other kinds of problems?

My performance at work and school is actually fine, I haven't noticed any issues there. But, kind of like I mentioned a few minutes ago, it's really my social life that's taking the hit. 

The main problem is just how isolated I've become. I'm still skipping out on those cooking nights with my friends and family because I'm just so paranoid they'll figure out how much I've been eating when I'm alone. So outside of my job and my classes, I'm pretty much just keeping to myself.
Have these episodes or your feelings about them started to affect your mood, self-esteem, or lead to any other emotional difficulties, like feeling down or anxious most days?

No, I wouldn't really say so. I mean, I feel guilty right after I eat like that, like I mentioned earlier, but... it doesn't really carry over into the rest of my week. I don't feel down or anxious most days. My mood is generally fine, and my self-esteem hasn't really changed, other than just feeling embarrassed about the eating itself. So, no, I don't think I'm having any major emotional problems like that.
